definitions.explanation: An involuntary spasm of the diaphragm that causes a sudden intake of breath, producing a characteristic sound.

examples.japanese: しゃっくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
しゃっくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだら→飲む：00322_nomu⟧しゃっくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: The hiccups stopped after I drank some water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{食|た}べたら→食べる：00396_taberu⟧しゃっくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I got hiccups because I ate too quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しゃっくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなく→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めて→止める：00678_tomeru⟧⟦みたら→みる：00283_miru⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't stop hiccupping during a meeting, and it got a little better when I tried holding my breath.

notes:
しゃっくり refers to hiccups — the involuntary spasm that causes a sudden intake of breath. Can be used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: しゃっくり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to hiccup).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- しゃっくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to get the hiccups
- しゃっくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: hiccups stop
- しゃっくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: can't stop hiccupping
- しゃっくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: to stop hiccups (intentionally)

FOLK REMEDIES:
Japan has similar folk remedies to English-speaking countries:
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: drinking water
- ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: holding one's breath
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}かせる→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧: startling/surprising someone

ALTERNATE FORMS:
Also written as しゃっくり or ひゃっくり. The kanji form {吃逆|しゃっくり} exists but is rarely used.
